purpose: Describe unrestricted action, availability, or neglect.
keywords: At this restaurant you can eat as many vegetables as you like.
The grass in the garden has been left to grow unchecked.
They said whatever they liked about me.
restrictions: 食べ放題 is a service; 荒れ放題 describes an unchecked state.
mistake: Do not assume every use means permission.
